content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Albany

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Albany professionals entering project management roles across government, healthcare, and higher education sectors. Verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course delivered entirely online. This intensive format compresses CAPM fundamentals into a focused schedule, allowing you to balance certification training with your current role in Albany's competitive job market while earning required contact hours.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your education hours, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application online. You'll pay the PMI exam fee at this stage. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process to ensure all documentation is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides, to solidify your knowledge of project management processes and terminology. Schedule your computer-based exam when ready. Many candidates complete the exam within weeks of finishing the boot camp.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After passing the exam, you'll earn your CAPM credential valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) across the renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU opportunities to help you stay current and advance your project management career.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
